sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners of both the cases and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 02 and learned APPs for the State.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.44094 of 2024(3) dt.11-07-2024 2.
It has joinly been submitted by learned counsels for both the parties that the matter has been settled between the parties.
3. In view of the above, the prosecution of the petitioners and other accused persons will serve no purpose.

4. Accordingly, these applications are allowed and the FIR bearing Barbigha P.S. Case No. 189 of 2023 registered for the offence under Sections 498A, 341, 323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act is hereby quashed with regard to all the accused persons.
5. The Prinicipal Judge, Family Court, Sheikhpura is directed to expedite the trial of the pending Divorce Case between the parties.
6. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the District Judge, Sheikhpura through FAX for its compliance.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Vikas/-
